enonce.texte:
Match the technology term with its definition.

  • 1. Smartphone
  • 2. Laptop
  • 3. Social media
  • 4. Application

Options: A. A software program for a specific task on a phone or computer. B. A portable computer. C. A mobile phone with advanced features. D. Online platforms where people share content and communicate.
images: Icons of a smartphone, a laptop, social media logos, and a mobile app icon.

enonce.texte: Fill in the blanks with the correct logical connector: and, but, because, so, however.

sousQuestions.texte: I like social media ______ it helps me connect with friends.
I want a new phone ______ I don't have enough money.
She has a laptop ______ a tablet.
He is sick, ______ he is staying home.

intitule: Resource: Advantages and Disadvantages of Technology

enonce.texte: Read the statements. Identify whether they are advantages (A) or disadvantages (D) of technology.

sousQuestions.texte: People can become addicted to social media.
Using too much technology can cause health problems.
Students can learn online from anywhere.

intitule: Competence: Explaining How to Use an App

enonce.texte: You want to teach your grandmother how to use WhatsApp. Write a simple step-by-step explanation.

questions.reponse: Example: First, download WhatsApp from the app store. Then, open the app. Enter your phone number. Next, add contacts. To send a message, click on a contact and type your message. Finally, press the send button.

intitule: Competence: Discussing Technology in Daily Life

enonce.texte: Write a paragraph about how technology is useful in your daily life. Use at least three logical connectors (and, but, because, so, however).

questions.reponse: Example: Technology is very useful in my daily life. I use my smartphone to communicate with my family and friends. I also use it to read the news and watch videos. However, I try not to use it too much because it can be distracting. Technology helps me learn new things because I can find information online easily. So, I think technology is a great tool when used wisely.

enonce.texte: Match the social media action with its description.

sousQuestions.reponse: Share a photo or text online.
Show that you approve of a post.
Write a reply to a post.
Send a post to other people.

intitule: Competence: Pros and Cons of Social Media

enonce.texte: Write a dialogue between two friends discussing the advantages and disadvantages of social media.

questions.reponse: Example: A: Do you like social media? B: Yes, but I think it has disadvantages too. A: I agree. What do you think is the main advantage? B: It helps us stay in touch with people far away. However, it can be very addictive. A: Yes, and I think it also spreads fake news. But I like it because I can learn new things.

intitule: Resource: Giving Instructions with Logical Connectors

enonce.texte: Complete the instructions with the correct logical connector: first, then, next, finally.

sousQuestions.texte: ______, press 'Enter' to go to the site.

enonce.texte: Write arguments for and against the statement: 'Technology is making people less social.'

questions.texte: Write a paragraph for each side (pro and con).
questions.reponse: Example (For): Technology can make people less social because they spend too much time on devices and less time talking face-to-face. However, it can also connect people. Against: Technology connects people across the world. It allows families to stay in touch. It also helps people make new friends online.

enonce.texte: You are a technology expert. Write a short guide for beginners on how to use a smartphone safely.

questions.reponse: Example: Welcome to the smartphone guide! First, set up a password to protect your phone. Then, download only trusted apps. Be careful when you share personal information online. Also, do not click on suspicious links. Finally, take breaks from your phone to rest your eyes. Enjoy your smartphone safely!
